weapon.d:
Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-5 on foes within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit and neutralizes effects that grant "Special cooldown charge +X" to those foes during their combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, unit deals +X × 5 damage during combat (max 20; X = number of foes within 3 spaces of target, including target; excluding area-of-effect Specials).

assist.d: Unit and target ally swap spaces.

a.d: If unit or foe initiates combat after moving to a different space, grants bonus to unit's Def/Res during combat = X + 1. (X = number of spaces from start position to end position of whoever initiated combat; max 1).

If unit or foe initiates combat after moving to a different space, grants bonus to unit's Def/Res during combat = X + 3. (X = number of spaces from start position to end position of whoever initiated combat; max 2).

If unit or foe initiates combat after moving to a different space, grants bonus to unit's Def/Res during combat = X + 5. (X = number of spaces from start position to end position of whoever initiated combat; max 3).

c.d: Allies within 2 spaces gain: "If foe uses sword, lance, axe, dragonstone, or beast damage, grants Def/Res+2 during combat."
Allies within 2 spaces gain: "If foe uses sword, lance, axe, dragonstone, or beast damage, grants Def/Res+3 during combat."
